title: 第一卷 南域篇 第7章 大道繁简取一瓢第一卷 南域篇 第8章 论剑
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
“你想过走出这里，去看九州天下吗？”陈元方想了一整天，躺在床上，终于起身，推开爷爷的房门，看着同样未眠的老人，说：“爷爷，我想修行。”
语气坚定。
月光透亮，照在男孩稚嫩的侧脸，坚定不移。
老人沉默良久，从铺着芦苇凉席的床头下，摸出那本尘封十年的道门心法，《武德真经》，叹了口气，牵起孙儿的手。
“我去求柳灵大人，请他教你。”村长说，将十年前无名剑侠留下的心法攥在手中，看着陈元方的眼睛。
“嗯！”陈元方坚定地点头。
入夜，柳庄后山。
星盘如柩，月锁乾坤。银流瀑布垂落水潭，水声淙淙，金声玉振。山顶空地，谢玄负手而立，夜风吹动他满头灰白色的长发，如竹林喧叶。
他在等，等子时降临，天地阴阳交替的瞬间。
白泽盘膝而坐，面朝太阳升起的地方，五心朝阳，舌顶上颚。
他也在等，等谢玄传他《纯阳真经》。
“日月轮回，时序交替。”谢玄没有喝酒，可声音却如醉如痴，“天道无极，衍生太极，化而两仪，是为阴阳。子时阴极而阳动，午时阳极而阴生。一阴一阳，遂有万物化育。”
白泽敛息守意，身如老松。
子时将近，阴阳之气开始变幻。某一瞬间，谢玄掐指一算，猛然抬头，星宫轮盘，至阳火德星从离宫升起，沿万古不变的古老星轨，划向星宫中央。
“子时已至，白泽听旨！”谢玄气如洪钟，声声直击白泽心神，“万物变化，固无休息。斡流而迁，或推而还。形气转续，变化而蟺。”
《纯阳真经》被谢玄张口念来，练气、运气之法，尽在其中。
“水激则旱，矢激则远；万物回薄，振荡相转。云蒸雨降，纠错相纷；大钧播物，坱圠无垠。”谢玄道骨仙风，高声传度，“天地为炉，造化为工；阴阳为炭，万物为铜。合散消息，安有常则？千变万化，未始有极！”
足足三刻，谢玄将全部纯阳心法传度白泽。
白泽老僧入定，感应阴阳，练气入体，开辟苦海。
红尘第一境，苦海境。

即修士练气入体，破丹田气海屏障，以成苦海。因此境需连破九道屏障，也被九州修士称为苦海九重天。
“接下来，就看你自己的了，能否在第一次就顺利开尘，凝聚气海，入苦海境……”谢玄站在山崖之巅，坐观星空与林间风月，心说：“寻常修士练天地灵气不分阴阳，已是不易。如今你要练纯阳，先分阴阳，再练纯阳之气，更是艰难。”
白泽陷入了一个玄妙的世界。
精神入定，进入冥想，他看到了一个无边的，只有气的世界。
那是一个五彩斑斓，玄之又玄的奇妙世界，有金木水火土五行灵气，分别对应五种颜色，流转天地之间。
有至阴气团高悬苍穹，无数星辰之灵为之点缀，肉眼所见之夜空，也是气息纵横流转，如极光交织。
有至诡魔气粘稠浓郁，如凝血令人毛骨悚然。
亦有万物之精行走无穷宇宙，山川之灵纵横八荒。
还有众多连白泽闻所未闻的能量静静流转，不知为何物。
极远的地方，有狂暴雷气毁天灭地。
极深的大地土气之下，有流动的地火一片赤红。
看不见的幽深之处，还有至寒冰灵镇守一方。
content_en:
"Have you ever thought about walking out of here and seeing the world of Jiuzhou?" Chen Yuanfang thought for a whole day, lying on the bed, and finally got up, opened the door of his grandfather's room, looked at the old man who was also awake, and said, "Grandpa, I want to practice."
The tone was firm.
The moonlight shines brightly on the boy's young face, unwaveringly.
The old man was silent for a long time. From under the bedside covered with reed mats, he took out the Taoist spiritual method, "Wude Zhenjing", which had been dusty for ten years. He sighed and took his grandson's hand.
"I'm going to ask Mr. Liu Ling to teach you." The village chief said, holding in his hand the mental technique left by the unknown swordsman ten years ago, and looking into Chen Yuanfang's eyes.
"Yeah!" Chen Yuanfang nodded firmly.
At night, there is a mountain behind Liuzhuang.
The astrolabe is like a coffin, and the moon locks the universe. The silver waterfall falls down into the pool, the sound of water is gurgling, and the sound of gold jade vibrates. In the open space on the top of the mountain, Xie Xuan stood with his hands behind his back, and the night wind blew his long gray hair like noisy leaves in a bamboo forest.
He was waiting, waiting for the moment of time to come, the moment when heaven and earth alternate between yin and yang.
Bai Ze sat cross-legged, facing the rising sun, with his five hearts facing the sun and his tongue on the roof of his mouth.
He was also waiting for Xie Xuan to teach him the "Chun Yang Zhen Jing".
"The sun and the moon cycle, and the time sequence alternates." Xie Xuan did not drink, but his voice was intoxicated, "The heaven is infinite, derived from Tai Chi, and transformed into two rituals, which are yin and yang. At the time of the child, the yin pole moves and the yang moves, and at noon the yang pole creates yin. One yin and one yang, then all things are transformed and nurtured."
Bai Ze held his breath and guarded his mind, his body was like an old pine tree.
As the time approaches, the yin and yang energy begins to change. At a certain moment, Xie Xuan counted with his fingers and suddenly raised his head, looking at the Star Palace Roulette, the Yanghuo Virtue Star rose from the Li Palace and moved towards the center of the Star Palace along the ancient star path that remained unchanged throughout the ages.
"The time has come, and Bai Ze listens to the order!" Xie Xuan's energy was like a bell, and the sound directly hit Bai Ze's mind. "Everything changes, and there is no rest. It moves with the flow, or pushes back. The shape and energy continue, change and fly."
"Chun Yang Zhen Jing" was read out by Xie Xuan, and the methods of practicing Qi and luck were all contained in it.
"When the water stirs up, there is drought, when the arrow stirs up, it goes far; everything becomes thinner, oscillating and turning. Clouds evaporate and rain falls, correcting and correcting each other; the great Jun sows things, and the land is boundless."
For three full moments, Xie Xuan transmitted all the Pure Yang Heart Techniques to Baize.
The old monk Baize entered meditation, sensed yin and yang, practiced qi into the body, and opened up the sea of ​​suffering.
The first realm of the world of mortals, the realm of the sea of ​​suffering.
That is, monks practice Qi into the body and break the barrier of Qi in Dantian to create a sea of ​​suffering. Therefore, the state needs to break through nine barriers in a row, which is also called the Nine Heavens of the Sea of ​​Bitterness by the Jiuzhou monks.
"Next, it depends on you, whether you can successfully open the dust, condense the sea of qi, and enter the sea of suffering in the first time..." Xie Xuan stood on the top of the cliff, sitting and watching the starry sky and the wind and moon in the forest, saying in his heart: "It is not easy for ordinary monks to practice the spiritual energy of heaven and earth without distinguishing yin and yang. Now you have to practice pure yang, first separate yin and yang, and then practice pure yang energy, it is even more difficult."
Bai Ze fell into a mysterious world.
After entering into meditation, he saw a boundless world filled with only Qi.
It was a colorful, mysterious and wonderful world, with the five elements of spiritual energy of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, corresponding to the five colors, flowing between heaven and earth.
There is a cloud of Yin air hanging high in the sky, decorated with the spirits of countless stars. The night sky visible to the naked eye also has breath flowing vertically and horizontally, like the intertwining of aurora.
There is a very strange demonic energy that is so thick and thick that it is as scary as clotted blood.
There are also the spirits of all things walking in the infinite universe, and the spirits of mountains and rivers traversing the wilderness.
There is also a lot of energy that even Bai Ze has never heard of flowing quietly, and he doesn't know what it is.
Far away, there was violent thunder that destroyed the sky and the earth.
Under the deep earth atmosphere, there is flowing earth fire that is red.
In the unseen depths, there is still an ice spirit guarding the place.
